mapper.sql: id, spu_id, sku_code, sku_name, spec_json, spec_summary, sale_price, tenant_id, version, deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `sku` (spu_id, sku_code, sku_name, spec_json, spec_summary, sale_price, tenant_id, version, deleted_at) VALUES (#{spuId}, #{skuCode}, IFNULL(#{skuName}, ''), IFNULL(#{specJson}, '[]'), IFNULL(#{specSummary}, ''), IFNULL(#{salePrice}, 0), #{tenantId}, 0, NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE `sku` SET sku_name = #{skuName}, spec_json = #{specJson}, spec_summary = #{specSummary}, sale_price = IFNULL(#{salePrice}, sale_price), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM `sku` WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE `sku` SET deleted_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
